asr_text: Of course, you can't bring in just anything you like; only works and characters approved by their original creators can be used. The help page also explains that the service has permission to use the original works it features through formal agreements with their creators. This is the foundation that lets you enjoy freely imagining what if. The service first offered two works and four characters in Japan. Taking part in a story here means moving the story forward through conversation or making a story as a fan. The fun of reading a work is joined by the fun of thinking up what happens next. Until now, if it were me, I'd do it this way was something you could only say to yourself. With Baias, those words become a way into making a story. What will you say to a character you love? What will happen next in the story? So, where will your next part begin?
